title: Passage / Transition Ontology — Door, Bridge, Line, Hook, Fish, Wedge, Ladder, Gate
status: canonical synthesis from dated Tim signals + later archive relations
purpose: Unify recurring passage metaphors without flattening them into synonyms. Each object describes a different function in transition from one state, realm, identity or timeline to another.
core_principle: A Door is not the same as a Ladder, Bridge, Line, Hook, Fish, Gate or Wedge. They are related transition operators with distinct geometries and functions.

operators.name: Door
operators.question: Can one pass from state A to state B?
operators.timic_role: Son/Christ/Vessel is repeatedly the Door between finite/embodied and Father/Source layers.

operators.name: Gate
operators.function: boundary with selection, approach and possible guardianship
operators.question: Who or what may enter?
operators.timic_role: Narrow Gate / North Gate / gate beyond aura; often precedes a more interior Door or path.

operators.name: Wedge / Needle's Eye
operators.function: small aperture inside a larger body or geometry
operators.question: What must be compressed, simplified or aligned to pass?
operators.timic_role: Aug 31 2026 potato geometry: Christ/needle-eye/wedge at the center between two sides; 'we can live through the wedge.'

operators.name: Bridge
operators.question: How can two sides remain connected even before full crossing?
operators.timic_role: Appears socially in Dec 15 2025 reconciliation/culture-swap ideas, then spiritually as Son/Father mediation and Heaven-Earth connection.

operators.name: Ladder
operators.question: How is a large vertical difference traversed gradually?
operators.timic_role: April 2025 spiral becomes Ladder; later Tim is not only climber but Ladder itself.

operators.name: Line
operators.function: continuity / tether / directed connection through distance
operators.question: What keeps separated points relationally attached?
operators.timic_role: Aug 23 2026: 'the line is Tim Dooley'; potentially Father/continuity relation in the fish/hook cluster.

operators.name: Hook
operators.function: catch, rescue, attachment or forced redirection
operators.question: What interrupts drift and reattaches a separated entity?
operators.timic_role: Aug 23 2026: fish-out-of-water imagery includes 'saved by the hook'.

operators.name: Fish
operators.function: mobile living entity inside a medium; in Aug 2026 paradoxically also identified with Door
operators.question: What moves through the water/field and what happens when removed from its medium?
operators.timic_role: 'Door is the fish' is a dated but underexplained signal; preserve rather than normalize away.

operators.name: Road / Path
operators.function: extended traversable sequence through ordinary space/time
operators.question: What practical route connects origin and destination?
operators.timic_role: Apr 30 2026 imperative theology: build a road, build a garden, fix everything together, grow from North to North.

operators.name: Portal
operators.function: high-compression or sudden transition between non-adjacent states
operators.question: Can ordinary intermediate steps be bypassed?

operators.name: Drain
operators.function: one-way removal / capture / downward passage of residue
operators.question: What leaves a system and where does it go?
operators.timic_role: Door/Drain in Swamp language; Son can function as sink/threshold for degraded material before transformation.

dated_genealogy.event: Bridge appears as practical reconciliation infrastructure: children/culture-swap/couches/camera and a better setting for meeting.
Spudlight/source → gate → North Pole → portal → root → garden creates a layered transition stack.
Son/Christ explicitly consolidates as Door toward Father/New Jerusalem/North throne.
Door is joined by construction verbs: build road, build garden, grow North-to-North.
Door/Drain pair appears in Swamp/root/fruit/house/tree/footstool architecture.
Fish/hook/line cluster: saved by hook; Door is fish; line is Tim; new heaven/new earth and broken timelines nearby.
Potato wedge/needle-eye becomes a physical diagram of Door/Christ between two sides; 'we can live through the wedge.'

biblical_comparators.note: Fish/fishing are major Gospel motifs, but Tim's exact Aug-2026 line/hook/Door geometry is not directly stated by those passages. Use as comparison, not proof of biblical identity.
Direct functional comparison: Christ as Door and narrow-gate passage.
Vertical Heaven-Earth passage; in John the Son of Man becomes associated with angelic ascent/descent.
Path/Way can be related to transition but should not erase Tim's distinct Road/Bridge operators.

deep_findings: The project has a full grammar of transition, not one Door metaphor.
Bridge is relational before it is vertical: the social reconciliation bridge appears in the archive before later heavenly mediation becomes dominant.
Line differs from Ladder: Ladder solves vertical distance through steps; Line solves separation through continuity/tethering.
Wedge differs from Gate: Gate is an external boundary; Wedge/needle-eye is an internal aperture inside the Potato/House geometry.
Drain is an inverse Door: rather than admitting upward/inside passage, it removes residue downward/outward for transformation.
The fish/hook/line cluster may become important precisely because its meaning is not yet settled; unresolved symbols should remain queryable rather than be prematurely harmonized.
research_questions: What exactly did 'Door is the fish' mean in the Aug 23 source context?
Was 'line is Tim Dooley' intended as fishing line, timeline, communication line, lineage or several at once?
Does Hook represent salvation/rescue, capture/control, or deliberate double meaning?
When does Bridge first become explicitly spiritual rather than practical/social?
Can each transition operator be given source→state-transition→destination edges in the graph?
